fields.description: Issue features extensive local political coverage ahead of the November 15, 1949 Miami city commission primary, including discussion of the Greater Miami Crime Commission and candidate positions on law enforcement. Includes editorials and letters protesting Dade County taxation and assessments and criticizing zoning decisions affecting developments such as West Shores near Miami Shores. Reports and commentary address alleged baby-placement activity and related publicity, along with other local civic topics (jail crowding, driving offenses, public utilities/telephone complaints, and transportation). International political reporting focuses on Cuban politician Jose Manuel Aleman and a proposed U.S.–Cuban loan, with references to Miami Beach connections.
